summary: The RPM installer is installed with `sudo dnf install --enablerepo=ansible-automation-platform-2.6-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms ansible-automation-platform-installer` and places files in `/opt/ansible-automation-platform/installer`; it is deprecated and removed in 2.7.
questions: How do I install the AAP installer RPM?
Where does the RPM installer put its files?

answer_card.title: Install the AAP 2.6 RPM installer
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo dnf install --enablerepo=ansible-automation-platform-2.6-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms \
  ansible-automation-platform-installer
```
The repo is disabled by default, hence `--enablerepo`. Files go to `/opt/ansible-automation-platform/installer`. The RPM installer is deprecated and will be removed in 2.7.
